paper_metadata.title: The evolution of dual-phase core–shell structure and mechanical properties induced by Co addition in as-cast high-entropy intermetallic

evidence.quote: In this work, three as-cast L1 2-type HEIs with different content of Co element were carefully examined combined with TEM, SEM and XRD technologies.

Combined with the designed nominal chemical composition, an equilibrium atomic molar ratio of Ni:Al + Si + Ti = 3:1 was acquired inside the grain without any composition cluster. Therefore, single L1 2-type ordered phase with Ni 3(Al, Si,Ti) structural formula was formed in Co0 alloy.

evidence.section: 4.3. Anomalous yield effect of as-cast Co1 alloy with DPCS structure
